summary: Submitted the fixed restart/durable-vote experiment for @q_restart_vote: three real in-process raft instances over InmemTransport, a real RequestVote RPC delivered into a target follower's transport consumer for candidate A in a future term (with LeadershipTransfer set and last-log values taken from the target, so the known-leader and log-up-to-date rules do not mask the vote decision), sampling the granted flag and the durable LastVoteTerm/LastVoteCand keys, then shutting the target down and rebuilding a Raft over the same log/stable/snapshot stores, transport and FSM before replaying requests for the same candidate, a different candidate in the same term, and a different candidate in an older term. The harness compiles cleanly against the snapshot (go vet in the local fixed-input workspace); the measured interpretation is left for the retained controller receipt.
